identity.name: Paco Sery
identity.summary: Ivorian drummer, percussionist and bandleader in jazz fusion and world music: Joe Zawinul’s Syndicate (My People, Faces and Places), Sixun, Eddy Louiss, and records with Manu Dibango, Papa Wemba, Salif Keita and Ray Lema.

contribution.description: An African drummer at the centre of world-music jazz fusion: the drummer of Joe Zawinul’s Syndicate and of the French band Sixun, and of records by Manu Dibango, Salif Keita and Papa Wemba.
